Most delegation problems are brief problems. A short brief with the goal, the steps, an example and the deadline gets better work than a long call. There is a free fill-in template.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/how-to-write-a-task-brief?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tb1-brief

AI is fast at drafts, lists and first passes. A person decides what is right for your business. The guide compares a virtual assistant and an AI assistant task by task, including where AI alone is the better pick.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-vs-ai-assistant?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ai1-human

Compare the true cost of a local hire with a virtual assistant using your own numbers. Enter your hours, your local rate and your extra costs, and the calculator shows both side by side.

https://myremoteva.com/va-vs-employee?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=em1-calc

Compare a local hire with a virtual assistant using your own numbers. Free calculator.

https://myremoteva.com/va-vs-employee?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=em1-calc

Time zone overlap matters more than the hourly rate. A free planner shows the overlap for your city.

https://myremoteva.com/time-zones?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tz1-zones

Try 3 hours free first. The trial runs for 2 days, then the plan you choose starts.

https://myremoteva.com/pricing?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tr1-trial
